title: 電力電子散熱設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究損耗、熱阻網路與暫態熱容量；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate losses, thermal networks and transient heat capacity. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設元件損耗 20 W，接面至冷卻液總熱阻 1.8 K/W，冷卻液 35°C，穩態接面估計 71°C；若損耗 30 W，估計 89°C。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 W device loss, 1.8 K/W total junction-to-coolant resistance and 35°C coolant: steady junction temperature is 71°C; 30 W gives 89°C.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性穩態近似，熱阻依安裝、流量與溫度而變；不把資料表 RθJA 當成任意機箱熱阻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear steady approximation; resistance depends on mounting, flow and temperature. Datasheet RθJA is not arbitrary enclosure resistance.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.
